Emperor Wu, whose temple name was Shizu, bore the taboo name Ze and the style Xuanyuan; he was the Grand Progenitor's eldest son.
世祖 is the temple name Shizu, not a canonical title meaning Grand Successor; the replacement is accurate.

After peace was restored he was called to court as gentleman of the palace treasury and northern-campaign middle army aide, enfeoffed as Baron of Xiyang with three hundred households, and given concurrent posts as administrator of South Dongguan, colonel of fast cavalry, regular gentleman, and chief clerk on Liu Yun's pacifying staff, with acting charge of Xiangyang.

After peace was restored he was called to court as gentleman of the palace treasury and northern-campaign middle army aide, enfeoffed as Baron of Xiyang, and given concurrent posts as administrator of South Dongguan, colonel of fast cavalry, regular gentleman, and chief clerk on Liu Yun's pacifying staff, with acting charge of Xiangyang.
This unit names him 西陽縣子 only; 邑三百戶 belongs to the separate Gan enfeoffment in the next sentence.

When the affair was settled he was summoned as Gentleman of the Palace Treasury, middle army aide on the northern campaign, Baron of Xiyang with a fief of three hundred households, and concurrently Administrator of South Dongguan, Colonel of Fast Cavalry, regular gentleman, and chief clerk to Liu Yun's Pacifying Army, with acting appointment as administrator of Xiangyang.

When the affair was settled he was summoned as Gentleman of the Palace Treasury, middle army aide on the northern campaign, Baron of Xiyang, and concurrently Administrator of South Dongguan, Colonel of Fast Cavalry, regular gentleman, and chief clerk to Liu Yun's Pacifying Army, with acting appointment as administrator of Xiangyang.
The fief of three hundred households is absent from this unit and appears only with 贛縣子 in the following sentence.
In Yuanhui 4 he was made chief clerk to the Pacifying-West prince of Jinxi, interior administrator of Jiangxia, and acting inspector of Ying.
In Yuanhui 4 he was made chief clerk to the Garrison-West prince of Jinxi, interior administrator of Jiangxia, and acting inspector of Ying.
The Chinese office is 鎮西長史, Garrison-West chief clerk, not Pacifying-West (安西).

In Shengming 2, after victory, he became palace attendant, commanding Jiangzhou and the Yuzhou commanderies of Xincai and Jinxi, was made general who punishes the barbarians and inspector of Jiang, and kept his staff.

In Shengming 2, after victory, he became cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, commanding Jiangzhou and the Yuzhou commanderies of Xincai and Jinxi, was made general who punishes the barbarians and inspector of Jiangzhou, and kept his staff.
散騎常侍 is cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, not palace attendant (侍中), and 江州刺史 is inspector of Jiangzhou.

In the third year he became palace attendant, vice director of the masters of writing, grand general of the central army, and privy counselor equal to the three excellencies; he was raised to duke while keeping his staff, his command, and the army directorship.

In the third year he became cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, vice director of the masters of writing, grand general of the central army, and privy counselor equal to the three excellencies; he was raised to duke while keeping his staff, his command, and the army directorship.
The transferred civil honor is 散騎常侍, not 侍中; cavalier attendant-in-ordinary is the correct office.
the fourth year of Jianyuan, third month, day renxu: the Grand Progenitor died. He took the throne at once and proclaimed a general amnesty.
In the fourth year of Jianyuan, third month, day renxu, the Grand Progenitor died. He took the throne at once and proclaimed a general amnesty.
The annalistic date 建元四年三月壬戌 must open a grammatical English sentence; supplying In and a capital letter repairs the error without changing the sense.
Day gengwu: Prince Xiao of Yuzhang, minister of works, was made grand tutor.
Day gengwu: Prince Yi of Yuzhang, minister of works, was made grand commandant.
豫章王嶷 is Prince Yi, and 太尉 is Grand Commandant, not Grand Tutor.
Fifth month, day yichou: Ziliang, son of the marquis of Wenxi and administrator of Danyang, was made inspector of South Xuzhou.
Fifth month, day yichou: Ziliang, Duke of Wenxi and administrator of Danyang, was made inspector of South Xuzhou.
聞喜公子良 is Ziliang, Duke of Wenxi, in the title-plus-given-name pattern, not the son of a Marquis of Wenxi.
Day yiyou: Prince Xiao of Poyang took Yongzhou; Ziqing, son of the prince of Linru, took Ying.
Day yiyou: Prince Qiang of Poyang took Yongzhou; Ziqing, Duke of Linru, took Ying.
鄱陽王鏘 is Prince Qiang of Poyang, and 臨汝公子卿 is Ziqing, Duke of Linru, not another man’s son.

Day wuxu: Ziliang of Wenxi became prince of Jingling; Ziqing of Linru, prince of Luling; Zijing of Yingcheng, prince of Anlu; Zimao of Jiangling, prince of Jin'an; Zilong of Zhijiang, prince of Suixiang; the imperial son Zizhen, prince of Jian'an; the imperial grandson Zhaoye, prince of Nan.

Ziliang, Duke of Wenxi, became prince of Jingling; Ziqing, Duke of Linru, prince of Luling; Zijing, Duke of Yingcheng, prince of Anlu; Zimao, Duke of Jiangling, prince of Jin'an; Zilong, Duke of Zhijiang, prince of Suixiang; the imperial son Zizhen, prince of Jian'an; the imperial grandson Zhaoye, prince of Nan.
This unit has no 戊戌 date, and 聞喜公 etc. are the men’s own ducal titles before their given names.

Day wuxu: Ziliang, son of the Duke of Wenxi, was advanced to Prince of Jingling; Ziqing, son of the Prince of Linru, to Prince of Luling; Zijing, son of the Prince of Yingcheng, to Prince of Anlu; Zimao, son of the Prince of Jiangling, to Prince of Jin'an; Zilong, son of the Prince of Zhijiang, to Prince of Suixiang; the imperial son Zizhen to Prince of Jian'an; the imperial grandson Zhaoye to Prince of Nan.

Ziliang, Duke of Wenxi, was advanced to Prince of Jingling; Ziqing, Duke of Linru, to Prince of Luling; Zijing, Duke of Yingcheng, to Prince of Anlu; Zimao, Duke of Jiangling, to Prince of Jin'an; Zilong, Duke of Zhijiang, to Prince of Suixiang; the imperial son Zizhen to Prince of Jian'an; the imperial grandson Zhaoye to Prince of Nan.
Literal English invented Day wuxu from the next unit and misread 公 plus given name as filiation.
Day guimao: Chu Yuan, minister of works, became minister of works and general of agile cavalry.
Day guimao: Chu Yuan, minister of education, became minister of works and general of agile cavalry.
司徒 and 司空 are distinct ducal offices; Chu Yuan moved from situ to sikong, not from works to works.
Day gengzi: Dai Jingjing, left commander of the crown prince's guard, was made inspector of Xu.
Day gengzi: Dai Sengjing, left commander of the crown prince's guard, was made inspector of Xu.
戴僧靜 is Dai Sengjing; Jingjing misreads 僧.
Day gengzi: Dai Jingjing, Left Commander of the Crown Prince's Guard, was made inspector of Xuzhou.
Day gengzi: Dai Sengjing, Left Commander of the Crown Prince's Guard, was made inspector of Xuzhou.
The given name 僧靜 is Sengjing, not Jingjing.
Jin honored the two Princes of Langya, and honor fell on their line.
Jin honored the two princes, and honor fell on their line.
晉亮兩王 names two princes only; Langya is not in the Chinese.

In the second year, spring, the first month, on yihai, Si's inspector Lü Anguo was shifted to South Yanzhou; Northern Expedition General Prince Ziliang of Jiling became guardian general and concurrent minister of works; Northern Expedition chief clerk Liu Dun became inspector of Si.

In the second year, spring, the first month, on yihai, Si's inspector Lü Anguo was shifted to South Yanzhou; Northern Expedition General Prince Ziliang of Jingling became guardian general and concurrent minister of education; Northern Expedition chief clerk Liu Dun became inspector of Si.
竟陵 is Jingling, but the replacement still renders 兼司徒 as minister of works (司空).

In the second year, spring, the first month, on yihai day, Inspector of Si Lü Anguo was made Inspector of South Yanzhou; Northern Expedition General Prince Ziliang of Jiling was made Guardian General and concurrent Minister of Works; Northern Expedition chief clerk Liu Dun was made Inspector of Si.

In the second year, spring, the first month, on yihai day, Inspector of Si Lü Anguo was made Inspector of South Yanzhou; Northern Expedition General Prince Ziliang of Jingling was made Guardian General and concurrent Minister of Education; Northern Expedition chief clerk Liu Dun was made Inspector of Si.
Jingling is right, but 司徒 is Minister of Education, not Minister of Works.
On jisi, Pacifying North General Cheng Faqin became inspector of Ning.
On jisi, Ningshuo General Cheng Faqin became inspector of Ning.
The held title is 寧朔將軍, not 平北將軍.
On jisi day, Pacifying North General Cheng Faqin was made Inspector of Ning.
On jisi day, Ningshuo General Cheng Faqin was made Inspector of Ning.
The Chinese office is 寧朔將軍, distinct from Pacifying North (平北).
Han's Founder longed for Nanyang; Wei's Founder kept faith with Qiao.
Emperor Guangwu of Han lingered at Nanyang; Emperor Wen of Wei kept faith with Qiao.
漢光 is Emperor Guangwu of Han and 魏文 is Emperor Wen of Wei; Founder misidentifies Wei Wen.
In the sixth month, on gengxu, the King of Henan, Duke Yidu, was promoted to cavalry general.
In the sixth month, on gengxu, the King of Henan, Du Yihou, was promoted to Chariot and Horse General.
度易侯 is the personal name Du Yihou, not a ducal title, and 車騎將軍 is Chariot and Horse General.
In the sixth month, on gengxu day, the King of Henan, Duke Yidu, was advanced to Cavalry General.
In the sixth month, on gengxu day, the King of Henan, Du Yihou, was advanced to Chariot and Horse General.
度易侯 is a personal name and 車騎將軍 is Chariot and Horse General, not a bare Cavalry General.
On jiaxu, Wang Sengqian, Left Grandee of the Bright and palace grandee with golden seal and purple cord, died.
On jiaxu, Wang Sengqian, Left Grandee of the Bright and Equal to the Three Offices with independent headquarters, died.
開府儀同三司 is the honor of opening a headquarters with rites equal to the Three Offices, not a golden-seal purple-cord grandee.
On jiaxu day, Left Grandee of the Bright, Grandee of the Palace with Golden Seal and Purple Cord Wang Sengqian died.
On jiaxu day, Left Grandee of the Bright, Equal to the Three Offices with independent headquarters Wang Sengqian died.
The second title is 開府儀同三司, not 金印紫綬.
On wuwu, Minister of Works Wang Jian was made tutor of the heir apparent as well; heir apparent household administrator Xiao Shunzhi became colonel director of retainers.
On wuwu, Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Jian was made concurrent Tutor of the Heir Apparent; heir apparent household administrator Xiao Shunzhi became Leader of the Palace Guards.
尚書令 is Director of the Imperial Secretariat and 領軍將軍 is Leader of the Palace Guards, not Minister of Works or Colonel Director of Retainers.
On wuwu day, Minister of Works Wang Jian was made concurrent Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Heir Apparent Household Administrator Xiao Shunzhi was made Colonel Director of Retainers.
On wuwu day, Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Jian was made concurrent Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Heir Apparent Household Administrator Xiao Shunzhi was made Leader of the Palace Guards.
Literal English misidentifies both 尚書令 and 領軍將軍; the replacement restores the source offices.

In the fourth year, spring, the first month, on jiazi, Suizhou Prince Zilong, who governed South Langye and Pengcheng, became inspector of Jiang; Conquering the Barbarians chief clerk Zhang Gui became inspector of Yong; Conquering the Barbarians General Xue Yuan became inspector of Xu; Guardian General and concurrent minister of works Prince Ziliang of Jiling was promoted to cavalry general.

In the fourth year, spring, the first month, on jiazi, Suizhou Prince Zilong, who governed South Langye and Pengcheng, became inspector of Jiang; Conquering the Barbarians chief clerk Zhang Gui became inspector of Yong; Conquering the Barbarians General Xue Yuan became inspector of Xu; Guardian General and concurrent minister of education Prince Ziliang of Jingling was promoted to chariot-and-horse general.
竟陵 is Jingling, but the replacement still calls 司徒 minister of works and flattens 車騎將軍 to cavalry general.

In the fourth year, spring, the first month, on jiazi day, Suizhou Prince Zilong, administrator of the two commanderies of South Langye and Pengcheng, was made Inspector of Jiang; Conquering the Barbarians chief clerk Zhang Gui was made Inspector of Yong; Conquering the Barbarians General Xue Yuan was made Inspector of Xu; Guardian General and concurrent Minister of Works Prince Ziliang of Jiling was advanced in rank to Cavalry General.

In the fourth year, spring, the first month, on jiazi day, Suizhou Prince Zilong, administrator of the two commanderies of South Langye and Pengcheng, was made Inspector of Jiang; Conquering the Barbarians chief clerk Zhang Gui was made Inspector of Yong; Conquering the Barbarians General Xue Yuan was made Inspector of Xu; Guardian General and concurrent Minister of Education Prince Ziliang of Jingling was advanced in rank to Chariot and Horse General.
Jingling is right, but 司徒 is Minister of Education and 車騎將軍 is Chariot and Horse General.
Second month, day jiwei: the emperor's brother Xu was made king of Jinxi and Xuan king of Hedong.
Second month, day jiwei: the emperor's brother Qiu was made king of Jinxi and Xuan king of Hedong.
銶 is Qiu, not Xu; the second brother 鉉 remains Xuan.
Second month, day jiwei: the Emperor's younger brother Xu was made King of Jinxi, and Xuan King of Hedong.
Second month, day jiwei: the Emperor's younger brother Qiu was made King of Jinxi, and Xuan King of Hedong.
The given name 銶 is Qiu; Xu confuses it with another graph.
Barbarians in Yong and Si rose again and again; day dingyou: Xiao Jingxian, palace attendant, marched to pacify Yang, and Chen Xianda, protector of the army, to Wan and Ye.
Barbarians in Yong and Si rose again and again; day dingyou: Xiao Jingxian, intendant of Danyang, marched to Pingyang, and Chen Xianda, protector of the army, to Wan and Ye.
丹陽尹 is Intendant of Danyang, and 出平陽 sends him to Pingyang, not to pacify Yang.

In Yong and Si provinces the barbarians stirred repeatedly; on day dingyou, Palace Attendant Xiao Jingxian was sent out to pacify Yang, and Protector of the Army Chen Xianda was sent out to Wan and Ye.

In Yong and Si provinces the barbarians stirred repeatedly; on day dingyou, Intendant of Danyang Xiao Jingxian was sent out to Pingyang, and Protector of the Army Chen Xianda was sent out to Wan and Ye.
The office is 丹陽尹 and 平陽 is a place-name, not the verb pacify Yang.
Day renxu: Xiao Ying, king of Linchuan, grand general of agile cavalry and palace grandee with golden seal, died.
Day renxu: Xiao Ying, king of Linchuan, General of Agile Cavalry with the privilege of opening an office equal in ceremony to the Three Dukes, died.
驃騎將軍 is General of Agile Cavalry, and 開府儀同三司 is the Three-Dukes ceremonial privilege, not a golden-seal palace grandee.
Day renxu: Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grandee of the Palace with Golden Seal and Purple Cord, Xiao Ying, King of Linchuan, died.
Day renxu: General of Agile Cavalry, granted a separate office with ceremonial rank equal to the Three Dukes, Xiao Ying, King of Linchuan, died.
The original gold-seal rendering is wrong, but the proposed phrase ceremonial equal is ungrammatical.
Day renyin: Wang Yan, palace attendant, took Jiangzhou.
Day renyin: Wang Yan, intendant of Danyang, was made inspector of Jiangzhou.
丹陽尹 is Intendant of Danyang, and 江州刺史 is the inspectorship of Jiangzhou, not a palace attendantship.
Fifth month, day yisi: Wang Jian, director of the Masters of Writing, general of the guard, and palace grandee with golden seal, died.
Fifth month, day yisi: Wang Jian, director of the Masters of Writing, general of the guard, and grandee opening a staff equal in ceremony to the Three Excellencies, died.
The third title is 開府儀同三司, not a golden-seal palace grandee.
Day jiazi: Liu Shilong, newly removed as left vice director of the Masters of Writing, became director of the Masters of Writing.
Day jiazi: Liu Shilong, newly appointed left vice director of the Masters of Writing, became director of the Masters of Writing.
新除 marks a newly appointed Left Vice Director, not someone newly removed from that post.
Day jiazi: the newly removed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Shilong was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
Day jiazi: the newly appointed Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Shilong was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
新除 means newly appointed, the opposite of newly removed.
Day yiyou: Xiu, heir of the acting king of Henan, went out to take Qin and He.
Day yiyou: Xiuliudai, heir of the acting king of Henan, was made inspector of Qin and He.
休留代 is the heir’s personal name; 代 is not the verb went out.
Day yiyou: Acting King of Henan, heir Xiu, left to assume the post of Inspector of Qin and He provinces.
Day yiyou: Xiuliudai, heir of the acting King of Henan, was made Inspector of Qin and He provinces.
Parsing 休 as the name and 留代 as left to assume reverses the grammar of 休留代.

Xiao Rui, prince of Nanping and minister for the people, took Xiang; Xiao Ziliang, prince of Jingling, headed the Masters of Writing; Wang Xuanmiao, right guard general, took North Xu; Xiao Ziqing, prince of Luling and central army general, became general of chariots and cavalry; Xiao Zihan, prince of Nanhai and north bureau general, took Yan; Zhaowen, duke of Linru and supporter of the state, took South Yu; Wang Wenhe, champion general, took North Yan.

Xiao Rui, prince of Nanping and minister for the people, took Xiang; Xiao Ziliang, prince of Jingling and minister over the masses, concurrently headed the Masters of Writing; Wang Xuanmiao, right guard general, took North Xu; Xiao Ziqing, prince of Luling and central army general, became general of chariots and cavalry; Xiao Zihan, prince of Nanhai and north bureau general, took Yan; Zhaowen, duke of Linru and supporter of the state, took South Yu; Wang Wenhe, champion general, took North Yan.
司徒竟陵王子良領尚書令 names him Minister over the Masses concurrently directing the Masters of Writing.

Prince of Nanping Xiao Rui, Minister for the People, was made Inspector of Xiangzhou; Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Jingling Xiao Ziliang, held the Masters of Writing; Right Guard General Wang Xuanmiao was made Inspector of North Xuzhou; Central Army General, Prince of Luling Xiao Ziqing, was advanced to General of the Chariots and Cavalry; North Bureau General, Prince of Nanhai Xiao Zihan, was made Inspector of Yanzhou; Supporter of the State, Duke of Linru Zhaowen, was made Inspector of South Yuzhou; Champion General Wang Wenhe was made Inspector of North Yanzhou.

Prince of Nanping Xiao Rui, Minister for the People, was made Inspector of Xiangzhou; Minister over the Masses, Prince of Jingling Xiao Ziliang, concurrently held Director of the Masters of Writing; Right Guard General Wang Xuanmiao was made Inspector of North Xuzhou; Central Army General, Prince of Luling Xiao Ziqing, was advanced to General of the Chariots and Cavalry; North Bureau General, Prince of Nanhai Xiao Zihan, was made Inspector of Yanzhou; Supporter of the State, Duke of Linru Zhaowen, was made Inspector of South Yuzhou; Champion General Wang Wenhe was made Inspector of North Yanzhou.
Literal English took 司徒 as Director of the Masters of Writing and missed that 領尚書令 is concurrent tenure.
Second month, day renyin: Chen Xianda, pacifying-army general, became general of the garrison army.
Second month, day renyin: Chen Xianda, garrison-army general, concurrently took the central army leadership.
領中領軍 is concurrent central army leadership, but 鎮軍將軍 is garrison-army, not pacifying-army.
Second month, day renyin: Pacifying Army General Chen Xianda became General of the Garrison Army.
Second month, day renyin: Garrison Army General Chen Xianda concurrently assumed the office of Central Leader of the Army.
The original confuses 中領軍 with 鎮軍, and the replacement still calls 鎮軍將軍 Pacifying Army General.
Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: Xiao Liao, prince of Yuzhang and grand marshal, died.
Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: Xiao Yi, prince of Yuzhang and grand marshal, died.
豫章王嶷 is Xiao Yi; Liao invents another person from 嶷.
Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: Grand Marshal, Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Liao, died.
Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: Grand Marshal, Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Yi, died.
The given name 嶷 is Yi, not Liao.
Fifth month, day jisi: Xiao Ziliang, prince of Jingling and director of the Masters of Writing, took Yang.
Fifth month, day jisi: Xiao Ziliang, prince of Jingling and minister over the masses, took Yang.
The office carried into the Yangzhou posting is 司徒, not director of the Masters of Writing.
Fifth month, day jisi: Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Jingling Xiao Ziliang, was made Inspector of Yangzhou.
Fifth month, day jisi: Minister over the Masses, Prince of Jingling Xiao Ziliang, was made Inspector of Yangzhou.
Literal English again reads 司徒 as Director of the Masters of Writing.

Wang Jingze, grand general of agile cavalry, became minister of works; Xiao Qiang, king of Poyang and inspector of Jiangzhou, became general of the garrison army; Chen Xianda, pacifying-army grand general, took Jiangzhou; Cui Huijing, general of the right guard, took Yu.

Wang Jingze, grand general of agile cavalry, became minister of works; Xiao Qiang, king of Poyang and inspector of Jiangzhou, became leader of the army; Chen Xianda, pacifying-army grand general, took Jiangzhou; Cui Huijing, general of the right guard, took Yu.
領軍將軍 is Leader of the Army, not garrison-army general (鎮軍).

Grand General of Agile Cavalry Wang Jingze was made Minister of Works; Inspector of Jiangzhou Xiao Qiang, King of Poyang, was made General of the Garrison Army; Pacifying Army Grand General Chen Xianda was made Inspector of Jiangzhou; General of the Right Guard Cui Huijing was made Inspector of Yuzhou.

Grand General of Agile Cavalry Wang Jingze was made Minister of Works; Inspector of Jiangzhou Xiao Qiang, King of Poyang, was made Leader of the Army; Pacifying Army Grand General Chen Xianda was made Inspector of Jiangzhou; General of the Right Guard Cui Huijing was made Inspector of Yuzhou.
Literal English collides 領軍將軍 with 鎮軍; Leader of the Army matches the source.

Second month, day renwu: Xiao Ziqing, prince of Luling and general of chariots and cavalry, became grand general of agile cavalry and inspector of South Yu; Xiao Zijing, prince of Anlu and pacifying-army general, became general of chariots and cavalry.

Second month, day renwu: Xiao Ziqing, prince of Luling and general of chariots and cavalry, became agile-cavalry general and inspector of South Yu; Xiao Zijing, prince of Anlu and army-consoling general, became general of chariots and cavalry.
驃騎將軍 is not 驃騎大將軍, and 撫軍將軍 is distinct from 鎮軍; the replacement keeps that contrast.
Between Yang and Huai the granaries stand empty; bandits swarm, plunder one another, and hide in hills and lakes until fugitives cover the land.
Between the Yangtze and the Huai the granaries stand empty; bandits swarm, plunder one another, and hide in hills and lakes until fugitives cover the land.
江淮 is the Yangtze and the Huai; Between Yang drops the river and looks like a personal name.

The inner and outer palace guards who have long served the old lord's personal attendants—entrust them all to Xiao Chen, treat them generously and employ them as fits, and do not betray my dying wish.」
The long-serving commanders and attendants of the inner and outer palace guards—entrust them all to Xiao Chen, treat them generously and employ them as fits, and do not betray my dying wish.
The glued Chinese closer is an error, but 勞舊主帥左右 are veteran commanders and attendants, not merely the old lord’s personal attendants.

unresolvedReferences.description: Zheng Hun and Wang Jun are retrospective exempla; their own Western years are not given in this chapter.
Western year of this annalistic sequence (fourth month through Jing'an burial) is not stated in the owned chunk; packet reigns are empty.
Independent Western intervals for Emperor Wu of Han and Marquis Wen of Wei cannot be verified from the packet.
